import sys

def main():
    import sys
    import sys
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    a = [0] * n
    for i in range(n - 1):
        print(f"? {i + 1} {n}")
        sys.stdout.flush()
        s = int(sys.stdin.readline())
        if i == 0:
            a[i] = s
        else:
            a[i] = s - a[n - 1]
    print(f"? 1 2")
    sys.stdout.flush()
    s12 = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    a[n - 1] = (a[0] + a[1] - s12) // 2
    a[0] -= a[n - 1]
    a[1] -= a[n - 1]
    print("! " + " ".join(map(str, a)))
    sys.stdout.flush()

main()
